lines.trans: This cigarette already tastes bitter.
Just throw it out quickly into the trash bin.
All right, I want to go to the bathroom.
Wait, it is on fire over there, friends!
The neighboring restaurant is burning right now!
Are you sure that this is a real fire?
Of course, look at this black smoke.
People are running out of the building onto the street.
We urgently need to tell the boss about this.
Yes, he must know about this fire.
Drop the cigarette and let's go inside faster.
I am running after you, open the door.

meanings.en: to run (in one direction), to flee, to escape
meanings.note: irregular mixed conjugation: бегу, бежишь, ..., бегут

examples.trans: Run, Marina, before it's too late!
Where are you running so fast?

examples.text: Он всегда бросает вещи на пол.
examples.trans: He always throws things on the floor.

meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: не в моём вкусе = not my type
выбросить в окно = to throw out the window

examples.trans: He threw the mayor out the window.

meanings.en: to burn, to be on fire, to glow

examples.trans: The little flame is burning, but there is hardly any warmth.
The door is behind the wardrobe.

meanings.note: + infinitive; agrees with the subject: должна (f)

examples.trans: This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

examples.text: На огромной скорости машина врезалась в здание!
examples.trans: At huge speed the car crashed into the building!
This is an old, beautiful building.
I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.en: must, need to, it is necessary

examples.trans: We need to do even more.

meanings.note: + prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

meanings.note: a door, window, bottle, or business

examples.trans: I'm going to open it now.
They open the shop at nine.

meanings.note: начался пожар = a fire broke out

examples.trans: The firefighters quickly put out the fire.

meanings.en: to have a look, to take a look

meanings.note: takes the accusative; everyday synonym of о

examples.trans: He says nasty things about me.

examples.text: Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.

meanings.note: comparative of скоро used as adverb or particle

examples.trans: Let's go quickly to the studio!

examples.text: За соседним столиком сидели приятные люди.
examples.trans: Pleasant people were sitting at the next table.

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent

examples.trans: I need to make a phone call urgently.
The toilet is in the corridor.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.text: Что-то голос какой-то не очень уверенный.
examples.trans: Your voice doesn't sound very confident.
He answered in a calm, confident voice.

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: на улице холодно = it's cold outside

examples.text: На Московской улице перевернули ящики с мусором.

examples.trans: He was wearing a formal black suit.
